items.t: Speedometer and warning lights may not show at startup (recall)
Backup camera may freeze or go blank (recall)
Front or rear camera can short out from water inside (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front and rear cameras

items.t: Load capacity label may show wrong numbers (recall)
Check engine light for a crankcase vent hose code (P2C90)
items.note: On a car this new it is normally done free under warranty.

items.t: Check engine light for a turbo wastegate code (P0243)
items.note: On a car this new it is normally done free under warranty.

items.t: Heater blows cool after a hot restart
items.note: On a car this new it is normally done free under warranty.

items.job: Repair or replace damaged wiring harness sections
items.note: Owners report an average of about $4,000. Not covered by warranty; comprehensive insurance often pays.

items.t: Low oil pressure warning and milky oil after short trips in the cold
items.job: Oil and filter change (per Toyota bulletin T-SB-0104-21)
items.note: The bulletin has the shop check for a coolant leak first, then change the oil and filter. It is not a warranty labor operation, so expect to pay. YourMechanic: about $219–$226 for a Crown oil change ($249–$341 at shops). A coolant leak, if found, costs more.

items.t: Hybrid system warning light in freezing weather
items.job: Replace hybrid battery relay box (per Toyota bulletin T-SB-0085-23)
items.note: Bulletin labor time is 1.0–1.1 hours. Parts price is relay box G3850-48010 (online sale price to MSRP); the bulletin also lists a second box whose price we could not find. Covered by Toyota's 60-month/60,000-mile basic warranty on affected cars.
